## What's new

- Updates over Wi-Fi: MENU > Updates shows what's installed and what's newest, and downloads and installs a newer ChaOS with no computer. Once Wi-Fi is up, ChaOS says when there's a newer one; downloading and installing are up to you.

---

ChaOS 0.8.0 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v0.8.0-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.1.1](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.1.1) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v0.8.0-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
